title: WebClerk report hook
description: The config.hooks payload on a Report record. Write it here, paste it into the record, submit it to WCHQ.

point.description: Where this hook attaches, as model.phase. Must be declared in the wc:hook_points Setting.

before.description: Once on the selection; the pre-save phase for model saves.

during.description: Per record, while records are gathered.

after.description: Per record once results are known; the post-save phase for model saves.

athena.description: Written by WebClerk and WCHQ — do not hand-edit. Editing the rules drops clearance automatically.

when.description: Condition: run this rule only when each field equals its value.

when_changed.description: Condition: run this rule only when this field changed on this save.

require.description: Validate: field must be present and non-empty.

match.description: Validate: field must match this regular expression.

range.description: Validate: field must fall within [low, high].

block.description: Refuse the save with this message. Pre-save points with may_block only.

set.description: Write a value or a {{token}} to a field or JSON path. Must be inside may_set.

add_note.description: Append a note to the record's comments. Needs may_create: note.

create_action.description: Create an Action record. Needs may_create: action.

log.description: Log name — a name, never a path. Must be inside may_log. Lands in logs/hooks/<name>.jsonl.

append_log.description: Append one JSON line to a named log.

run_report.description: Run another report's after phase. Must be inside may_run. Depth 5, cycles refused.

message.description: The text a failed validate shows the user.
